children: Diös Fastigheter’s Interim Report for January-September 2026 will be published at 07:00 am (CEST) on 23 October 2026. The same day, at 09:30 am (CEST), investors, analysts, media and other stakeholders are invited to participate in the online audiocast with teleconference.
CEO David Carlsson and CFO Rolf Larsson will present and comment on the result for the period. The presentation will be held in English and will conclude with a Q&A session.
To participate in the teleconference, please dial in on any of the numbers below:
To access the presentation and conference online, please use this link.
Would you like to participate in the Q&A session? Please register in advance via this link.
The Interim Report and presentation will be available on dios.se.

Diös Fastigheter owns and develops commercial and residential properties in cities with growth potential. With a property value of SEK 32.8 billion, a portfolio of 308 properties and a lettable area of 1,540 thousand sq.m, our vision is to create Sweden’s most inspiring cities. The market extends from Borlänge to Luleå, and the company’s head office is in Östersund. Since it started in 2005, the company has had continuous growth in the value of its property portfolio and its shares are listed on NASDAQ OMX Stockholm, Mid Cap. Find out more about Diös at www.dios.se
